newsitem.title: KENYA: Egyptian military advisers fly out of Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian military advisers fly out of Zaire.

text.p: Eight Egyptian military advisers to the Zairean army flew out of the east Zairean town of Bunia on Monday as rebels advanced from the town of Beni to the south, missionary sources said.
The Egyptians took what could be the last missionary flight for some time out of Bunia and landed at Entebbe in neighbouring Uganda, the sources said.
Bunia, 1,800 km (1,100 miles) northeast of Kinshasa, was in a state of panic on Monday as residents heard that the rebels of the Alliance of Democratic Forces moved into Beni on Saturday.
The sources said the Egyptian advisers were desperate to leave Bunia and demanded seats on the missionary plane after learning that no more commercial flights would scheduled.
It was not clear how long the Egyptians had been in Zaire or what exactly their mission was.
